task: An nginx web server for Ansible on the host web01.example.com: install the nginx package, write its configuration file at /etc/nginx/nginx.conf with mode 0644, and keep the service running and enabled. The service reloads when the configuration file changes.
For Puppet on the host build01: a group named builders and a user named ci whose primary group is builders, with the group created before the user.
For Chef on the host app01: run the command /opt/app/bin/migrate once, only if the file /opt/app/.migrated does not exist yet.
A storage account in Bicep named stmeridiandemo in the location westeurope, with the Standard_LRS SKU and the StorageV2 kind.
A Terraform document with one AWS EC2 instance of type t3.micro from the image ami-0123456789abcdef0, tagged Name=web, and an output called instance_id that reads the instance's id.
A Kubernetes Deployment of three replicas of the image nginx:1.27 listening on port 80, and a Service of type ClusterIP in front of it on port 80.
For Docker: a web service from the image nginx:1.27 publishing port 8080 to 80, and a database service from postgres:16 with a named volume for its data; the web service starts after the database.

For Salt on the host db01: install the postgresql package and write /etc/app/db.conf containing a password that must not be written into the document; the password comes from the environment variable APP_DB_PASSWORD.
